description: Pedestrian Counting System (counts per hour) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne Open Data. This dataset contains hourly pedestrian counts since 2009 from pedestrian sensor devices located across the city. The data is updated on a monthly basis and can be used to determine variations in pedestrian activity throughout the day. Coverage: City of Melbourne Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne Open Data. Its tags are foot-traffic, pedestrian, safemobility, sensors, traffic-flow. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
